Kashmiri Youth Assaulted During Delhi Congress Protest, FIR Filed

A Kashmiri youth was assaulted during a Congress protest in Delhi, leading to an FIR being filed. The youth identified himself as a fan of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Following the attack on the Kashmiri youth, identified as Fahim Nazir, there was an uproar, with youth protesting on Gupkar Road and demanding an FIR against Rahul Gandhi.
